uncertainties: Vegetables Staples L2 is drawn as three adjacent bed stages; no season names are printed. Candidate follows the source’s temporal description and adds no timing.

preservation: Each candidate tracks canonical English count, numbers, order, spatial relations, and qualifiers; technical terms stay in English where translation could change meaning. Candidate-specific cautions are attached per row.
